title: Illusions of Pastoral Peace
question: What particular anxiety spoils the country dweller's visit to the theatre?

meanings.usage: 指看似真实但实际不存在的事物或想法
形容乡村或田园生活方式
常用复数形式raptures表示极度欣喜
形容光线反射的闪烁效果

meanings.meaning: 田园诗般的，完美无缺的
meanings.usage: 形容平静美好的乡村生活
表示对某事持怀疑态度
指认识但不太熟的人，区别于friend
形容坚持己见不肯改变的态度
形容因负重或疲劳而走路不稳
指某种状态或氛围突然到来

phrases.usage: 表示极度兴奋或欣喜若狂

examples.en: They always go into raptures at the mere mention of the country.
examples.zh: 他们一提到乡村就会欣喜若狂。

phrases.usage: 表示无法理解或超出能力范围

examples.en: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day is beyond me.
examples.zh: 我无法理解为什么人们愿意每天忍受四个小时的旅程。

phrases.usage: 表示没有某物也能应付，没有也行

examples.en: If you can do without the few pastoral pleasures of the country, you will find the city can provide you with the best.
examples.zh: 如果你能不要乡村的那点乐趣，你会发现城市能给你最好的生活。

examples.en: There is so much variety that you never have to make do with second best.
examples.zh: 品种繁多，你永远不必凑合用次品。

phrases.usage: 表示疯狂、放纵、胡乱购物

examples.en: Country people run wild when they go shopping in the city.
examples.zh: 乡下人进城购物时会疯狂采购。

phrases.usage: 表示接近尾声，即将结束

examples.en: As the play draws to its close, they wonder whether they will ever catch that last train home.
examples.zh: 当戏剧接近尾声时，他们担心能否赶得上最后一班回家的火车。

phrases.usage: 表示被藏起来，安置在某个地方

examples.en: The thousands that travel to work every day are tucked away in their homes in the country.
examples.zh: 每天成千上万进城工作的人都被藏在乡村的家中。

phrases.phrase: It has always been a mystery to me
phrases.usage: 表示对某人来说一直是个谜

examples.en: It has always been a mystery to me why city dwellers pretend they would prefer to live in the country.
examples.zh: 我一直不明白为什么城里人偏要假装喜欢住在乡下。

phrases.usage: 表示误以为，持有错误的观念

examples.en: Even he still lives under the illusion that country life is somehow superior to town life.
examples.zh: 甚至他仍然误以为乡村生活比城市生活优越。

phrases.usage: 表示为了某种不值得的特权/好处

examples.en: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country.
examples.zh: 为什么人们愿意每天忍受四小时的路程，就为了住乡下的那个并不值得的好处。

sentences.en: The quiet life of the country has never appealed to me.
sentences.zh: 宁静的乡村生活从来没有吸引过我。

sentences.en: City born and city bred,
sentences.zh: 我生在城里，长在城里，

sentences.en: I have always regarded the country as something you look at through a train window, or something you occasionally visit during the weekend.
sentences.zh: 始终认为乡村是透过火车车窗看的东西，或者至多是周末偶尔去逛逛的地方。

sentences.en: Most of my friends live in the city, yet they always go into raptures at the mere mention of the country.
sentences.zh: 我的大部分朋友都住在城里，然而他们一提到乡村就手舞足蹈。

sentences.en: Though they extol the virtues of the peaceful life,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们盛赞宁静生活的种种好处，

sentences.en: only one of them has ever gone to live in the country and he was back in town within six months.
sentences.zh: 但只有一个人去乡下住过，而且不到6个月就回到了城里。

sentences.en: Even he still lives under the illusion that country life is somehow superior to town life.
sentences.zh: 即使他，至今仍幻想乡村生活不知怎么的要优于城市生活。

sentences.en: He is forever talking about the friendly people, the clean atmosphere, the closeness to nature and the gentle pace of living.
sentences.zh: 他总是谈论那里的人们多么友好，空气多么清新，多么贴近大自然，生活节奏多么悠闲。

sentences.en: Nothing can be compared, he maintains, with the first cockcrow, the twittering of birds at dawn,
sentences.zh: 他坚持认为，没有什么能与第一声鸡鸣、黎明时鸟儿的啁啾相比，

sentences.en: the sight of the rising sun glinting on the trees and pastures.
sentences.zh: 也不能与旭日普照树林和牧场的景象相比。

sentences.en: This idyllic pastoral scene is only part of the picture.
sentences.zh: 这田园诗般的乡村景色只是部分景象。

sentences.en: My friend fails to mention the long and friendless winter evenings in front of the TV--virtually the only form of entertainment.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友没有提到在电视机前度过的漫长而孤寂的冬夜——这几乎是唯一的娱乐方式。

sentences.en: He says nothing about the poor selection of goods in the shops,
sentences.zh: 他没有提及商店里商品的选择少得可怜，

sentences.en: or about those unfortunate people who have to travel from the country to the city every day to get to work.
sentences.zh: 也没有提及那些每天不得不从乡下到城里上班的可怜人。

sentences.en: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond me.
sentences.zh: 为什么人们愿意每天忍受4个小时的车程，只为享受住在乡下这种可疑的优待，这真是超出我的理解。

sentences.en: They could be saved so much misery and expense if they chose to live in the city where they rightly belong.
sentences.zh: 如果他们选择住在他们本该居住的城市，就可以避免许多痛苦和花费。

sentences.en: If you can do without the few pastoral pleasures of the country, you will find the city can provide you with the best that life can offer.
sentences.zh: 如果你能放弃乡村那一点点田园乐趣，你就会发现城市能为你提供生活中最美好的东西。

sentences.en: You never have to travel miles to see your friends.
sentences.zh: 你永远不必跑很远的路去看望朋友。

sentences.en: They invariably live nearby and are always available for an informal chat or an evening's entertainment.
sentences.zh: 他们总是住在附近，随时都可以进行非正式的聊天或晚间娱乐。

sentences.en: Some of my acquaintances in the country come up to town once or twice a year to visit the theatre as a special treat.
sentences.zh: 我乡下的一些熟人每年进城一两次，看戏作为一种特殊的享受。

sentences.en: For them this is a major operation which involves considerable planning.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这是一项大工程，需要周密的计划。

sentences.en: As the play draws to its close, they wonder whether they will ever catch that last train home.
sentences.zh: 随着戏接近尾声，他们会担心是否能赶上最后一班回家的火车。

sentences.en: The city dweller never experiences anxieties of this sort.
sentences.zh: 城市居民从不会经历这种焦虑。

sentences.en: The latest exhibitions, films, or plays are only a short bus ride away.
sentences.zh: 最新的展览、电影或戏剧，只需坐一小段公交车就能到达。

sentences.en: Shopping, too, is always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 购物也总是一种乐趣。

sentences.en: There is so much variety that you never have to make do with second best.
sentences.zh: 品种如此繁多，你永远不必将就次等货。

sentences.en: Country people run wild when they go shopping in the city and stagger home loaded with as many of the exotic items as they can carry.
sentences.zh: 乡下人进城购物时会变得狂热，然后蹒跚着回家，身上背着尽可能多的异国情调的物品。

sentences.en: Nor is the city without its moments of beauty.
sentences.zh: 城市也并非没有它的美丽时刻。

sentences.en: There is something comforting about the warm glow shed by advertisements on cold wet winter nights.
sentences.zh: 在寒冷潮湿的冬夜，广告牌散发出的温暖光芒总能给人带来慰藉。

sentences.en: Few things could be more impressive than the peace that descends on deserted city streets at weekends
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么能比周末空旷的城市街道上降临的宁静更令人印象深刻，

sentences.en: when the thousands that travel to work every day are tucked away in their homes in the country.
sentences.zh: 当每天上班的成千上万人都在乡下的家中安睡时。

sentences.en: It has always been a mystery to me why city dwellers, who appreciate all these things,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，城市居民明明欣赏所有这些优点，

sentences.en: obstinately pretend that they would prefer to live in the country.
sentences.zh: 却固执地假装他们更喜欢住在乡下，这始终是个谜。

exercises.prompt: “牧场，草地” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: pasture · /ˈpæstʃə(r)/ · noun · 牧场，草地。指供牲畜吃草的地方

exercises.prompt: “表示在某种条件下可能会发生的情况，使用if引导，描述可能实现的假设。” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: If + 主语 + 一般现在时, 主语 + will/can/may + 动词原形
options: 条件状语从句（真实条件句）
It seems that 主语从句结构
百分数表达在描述数据中的应用
exercises.explain: 条件状语从句（真实条件句）：If + 主语 + 一般现在时, 主语 + will/can/may + 动词原形：用于提出真实的假设条件，说明条件与结果之间的关系。这类句子被称为第一类条件句，表示可能发生的情况。

source.title: 条件状语从句（真实条件句）

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond me.
options: 为什么人们愿意每天忍受4个小时的车程，只为享受住在乡下这种可疑的优待，这真是超出我的理解。
但更糟糕的还在后面。就在我们前方，有一道巨大的裂缝。
他被我们称为迪基，他的怪癖在他去世前很久就已成为传奇。
不用说，我们的房子现在被一片丛林包围着。
exercises.explain: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond me. — 为什么人们愿意每天忍受4个小时的车程，只为享受住在乡下这种可疑的优待，这真是超出我的理解。

source.en: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond me.

grammar.title: 宾语从句（Object Clause）
grammar.definition: 由连接词引导的充当句子宾语的从句，说明说话人对某事物的看法或疑问。
grammar.structure: 连接词（that/whether/why/what等）+ 主语 + 谓语 + 其他成分
grammar.usage: 用于表达观点、看法、疑问等内容，可位于动词或介词之后。常见动词如：think, believe, know, wonder, understand等后常接宾语从句。

examples.en: He still lives under the illusion that country life is somehow superior to town life.
examples.zh: 他仍然误以为乡村生活比城市生活优越。

examples.en: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day is beyond me.
examples.zh: 我不明白为什么人们愿意每天忍受四小时的路程。

examples.en: It has always been a mystery to me why city dwellers pretend they would prefer to live in the country.
examples.zh: 我一直不明白为什么城里人偏要假装喜欢住在乡下。

grammar.title: 否定副词置于句首的倒装句
grammar.definition: 含有never, seldom, rarely, little, nowhere, hardly等否定词或半否定词时，如置于句首，句子需要部分倒装。
grammar.structure: 否定词/半否定词 + 助动词/be动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.usage: 强调否定意义，使句子更加正式或文学化。阅读时需注意识别这种倒装结构。

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我从未见过如此美丽的日落。

examples.en: Seldom does he go to the theatre.
examples.zh: 他很少去看戏。

examples.en: Rarely can you find a place so quiet.
examples.zh: 你很少能找到如此安静的地方。

grammar.title: 条件状语从句（真实条件句）
grammar.definition: 表示在某种条件下可能会发生的情况，使用if引导，描述可能实现的假设。
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 一般现在时, 主语 + will/can/may + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于提出真实的假设条件，说明条件与结果之间的关系。这类句子被称为第一类条件句，表示可能发生的情况。

examples.en: If you can do without the few pastoral pleasures of the country, you will find the city can provide you with the best.
examples.zh: 如果你能不要乡村的那点乐趣，你会发现城市能给你最好的生活。

examples.en: If you work hard, you will succeed.
examples.zh: 如果你努力工作，你就会成功。

original.en: Nothing can be compared, he maintains, with the first cockcrow, the twittering of birds at dawn...
original.zh: 他坚持认为，没有什么能比得上清晨的第一声鸡鸣、鸟儿的啾啾叫声...

examples.en: Nothing can be compared with a mother's love.
examples.zh: 没有什么能比得上母爱。

examples.en: Nothing can be compared with the taste of fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 没有什么能比得上新鲜水果的味道。

original.en: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four-hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond me.
original.zh: 我无法理解为什么人们为了在乡村居住这个可疑的特权而愿意每天忍受四小时的旅程。

examples.en: Why she married him is beyond me.
examples.zh: 我无法理解她为什么要嫁给他。

examples.en: Why anyone would want to live there is beyond me.
examples.zh: 我无法理解为什么有人想住在那里。

original.en: There is something comforting about the warm glow shed by advertisements on cold wet winter nights.
original.zh: 在寒冷潮湿的冬夜，广告牌发出的温暖光芒有一种令人安慰的感觉。

examples.en: There is something mysterious about the old house.
examples.zh: 那座老房子有一种神秘的感觉。

examples.en: There is something fascinating about her stories.
examples.zh: 她的故事有一种迷人的魅力。

patterns.pattern: If you can do without..., you will find...

original.en: If you can do without the few pastoral pleasures of the country, you will find the city can provide you with the best that life can offer.
original.zh: 如果你能放弃乡村的那点乐趣，你就会发现城市能给你提供生活中最好的东西。

examples.en: If you can do without luxury, you will find life much simpler.
examples.zh: 如果你能不要奢侈品，你会发现生活简单得多。

examples.en: If you can do without constant entertainment, you will find time for what matters.
examples.zh: 如果你能不要不断的娱乐，你会发现时间去做重要的事。
